posts.text: OpenAI will reportedly ship at least one model this year but its flagship still needs alignment work. posts.text: Manacá-1B-Instruct-2: Reproducible Safety Alignment for a Native Brazilian-Portuguese LLM. Negative DPO Results, a Controlled Composition Scan, and a Silent Failure Mode of the LLM Judge. Brazilian Portuguese remains underserved by open-source language models, and the few that are safety-aligned rarely document what did not work or validate comparisons with statistical significance. We present Manacá-1B-Instruct-2, the second-generation post-training alignment of Manacá-1B (1.72B parameters, trained from scratch for PT-BR), with an SFT corpus of 291,223 examples. posts.text: Santander's Ana Botin on US Growth, Debt, AI and the Global Economy | The David Rubenstein Show. Santander Executive Chair Ana Botin sits down with David Rubenstein to discuss the bank's expansion in the US, including its recent acquisition of Webster Financial, and why she sees lack of economic growth as one of the biggest challenges facing the global economy.
